eyebrow: Step 3 · Sequence by risk reduction per effort
code:
Phase 1 (0-6mo)    Identity + Networks: Conditional Access, four segments, SDP broker
Phase 2 (6-14mo)   App/Workload + Devices: API gateway, BYOD compliance
Phase 3 (14-24mo)  Data: DLP, encryption audits, classification-driven access review
Phase 4 (ongoing)  Partner/Vendor: recurring least-privilege review of every integration
caption: Identity and Networks come first -- mostly configuration, biggest risk cut for the cost.

eyebrow: Step 4 · Write it for a budget committee
code:
phase: 1
timeframe: "0-6 months"
whatChanges: "SSO policy engine; clinical network split into 4 zones"
whyItMatters: "Removes the single biggest lateral-movement path into patient records"
riskIfDelayed: "One compromised clinic workstation can currently reach every patient record"
caption: whyItMatters and riskIfDelayed are the two lines that actually get budget approved.
